stem:
Meena tests four food samples in her school laboratory. She adds copper sulphate solution and caustic soda solution to each sample and notes the colour after five minutes.
Which result shows that the food sample contains protein?

options.text: Rice water turns blue-black with iodine
Groundnut oil makes a translucent spot on paper

teacher.key_rationale: A violet colour after adding copper sulphate solution and caustic soda solution (Biuret test) confirms protein; dal contains protein. Options B, C and D describe tests for starch, fat and a negative result respectively.
